reasons: Cited text directly supports the preferred position: § 2.1 states 'No minimum quantity or purchase commitment applies' and that declining to place further orders is not a breach or shortfall.
§ 7.1 bars Vendor from imposing minimum-use charges not in the Order Form, and § 12.3 confirms no minimum-volume commitment — no take-or-pay, shortfall penalty, or volume cap on Customer.
Consistent with a compliant status, no redline or comment is proposed and the redline is byte-identical to the originals; no deterministic check failures.
Rationale correctly distinguishes the audit-underpayment 'shortfall' references (§§ 22.2–22.3) and auto-renewal (§ 8.2) as outside this rule's scope.
